title: New route_tie violet is only 14.0 deg from router_tier_high (below the 15 deg node-signal canon); both are node-centered rings on routers
detail: The PR claims ">= 62 deg from every tier" but only checked pipe tiers. Router tier rings are also node rings, drawn on routers — exactly where ECMP split nodes are. Tritan-sim distance 21.9 fails the project's own 48 signal threshold.
recommended_fix: Add p.router_tier_basic/mid/high to the tiers array in the hue test; if it then fails (it will), shift route_tie hue (e.g. toward blue/magenta) to clear 15 deg from router_tier_high.

title: a11y oracle has no route_tie-vs-state_congested pair — the finding-A collision class remains unguarded under CVD mode tables
evidence:
harness/palcheck.odin:96-106 	append(&pairs, [2]rl.Color{p.state_healthy, p.state_congested})
	append(&pairs, [2]rl.Color{p.state_healthy, p.state_critical})
	append(&pairs, [2]rl.Color{p.state_congested, p.state_critical})
	...
	append(&pairs, [2]rl.Color{p.route_glow, p.route_tie})
app/render/palette.odin:396 	case "route_tie":        return .Route_Tie, true
app/render/palette_polish_test.odin:147 	expect_color(t, p.route_tie, {150, 94, 232, 235})  // base palette only, mode Off
detail: The old tables passed every gate while simulated tie-vs-congested distance was 0.0 (verified by recomputation). The new test pins only base/fallback bytes; re-adding a route_tie remap to "modes" still passes CI.
recommended_fix: Add append(&pairs, [2]rl.Color{p.route_tie, p.state_congested}) to a11y_separation_check, and the same pair to pair_list in tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py.

title: draw_tie_mark re-implements the draw_ring_annulus quad-fan geometry instead of sharing it
detail: The existing helper is draw_ring_annulus at app/render/spawn_fx.odin:384. The winding/culling lesson now lives in two copies in the same package; a future winding fix must touch both.
recommended_fix: Extend draw_ring_annulus with an optional segment predicate (default: all on) and have draw_tie_mark call it with tie_dash_on, single-sourcing the geometry.

title: derive_a11y_palettes.py cannot run against the shipped palette.json (// comments), so the derivation this diff edits is not reproducible
evidence:
tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py:97 PAL = json.load(open("data/palette.json"))
data/palette.json:11   "ink_soft_text": [66, 72, 80, 255], // 2026-08-23 (v2-font-overhaul): the TEXT-only contrast fold — the readability ruling darkens text while Rule 6 keeps gameplay surfaces on the pre-fold ink_soft
Reproduced: json.load fails with "Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 11 column 39".
detail: Pre-existing (font-overhaul added the comments) and disclosed in the PR body, but this diff edits the script's derivation logic; its output cannot be regenerated or verified against the shipped tables as-is.
recommended_fix: Strip // comments before json.load in the script (small regex prefilter), so the modes block stays reproducible and comparable to data/palette.json.
